propositions: The packaged code-review guide (passing-code-review.md lines 112–114) contains stale instructions for coverage-gap blocks, directing contributors to ping maintainers instead of using the self-service recheck-review mechanism.
Ticket bb9b implemented contributor-triggerable re-review via recheck-review comment, which was documented in review-policy.md and CONTRIBUTING.md but the packaged guide was not updated.
The stale guide text actively misdirects contributors because it is the primary discovery surface (rebar explain review) for the Gerrit LLM-Review gate onramp.
The coverage-gap bullet must be updated to name recheck-review as the self-service re-trigger and explain that recheck (CI) and recheck-review (LLM review) mirror each other.
